articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI bot got social-engineered into handing over Obama's Instagram to pro-Iranian hackers. When your security is dumber than the humans it replaced, you've achieved peak tech dystopia.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally published AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub, because apparently cybersecurity agencies can't secure their own damn secrets. Congress is rightfully losing their minds.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: CISA contractor left AWS GovCloud credentials on public GitHub like a digital rookie mistake of epic proportions. The agency that's supposed to protect our infrastructure couldn't protect its own keys.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI appointment proves why Section 702's warrantless mass spying needs immediate reform. When politics trumps competence, your privacy is the casualty.

articles.title: Exposed Fuel Tank Gauges Under Attack in the US
articles.summary: EFF testifies that government AI adoption without Constitutional safeguards is a recipe for digital authoritarianism. Someone has to speak truth to power about algorithmic overreach.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day under active attack with no patch available. Cisco's security track record makes Swiss cheese look bulletproof.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories in Major Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: AI agent autonomously discovers 21 zero-days in FFmpeg while Chrome patches a record 429 bugs. The machines are now better at finding vulnerabilities than we are.

articles.title: IronWorm and New Miasma Worm Variant Hit npm in Supply Chain Attacks
articles.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager zero-day (CVE-2026-20245) actively exploited with no fix in sight. Sysadmins everywhere are updating their resumes and stress-eating.

articles.title: Android Spyware Asin Targets Arabic Users via Fake News, PDF and War Map Apps
articles.summary: IronWorm and Miasma worms hit npm with supply chain attacks targeting 50+ packages. The software ecosystem remains as secure as a house of cards in a hurricane.

articles.title: Reporting from Vegas: Networking, AI, and good boys
articles.summary: Ethical hacker flags cloud misconfiguration at IIT Roorkee affecting JEE exam data, gets fixed immediately. Proof that responsible disclosure still works when orgs aren't idiots.
